Password Expiry Resource Update Password Expiry Settings
PUT
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/passwordExpiry/settings

Updates the password expiration information for all the admins

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
passwordExpirationEnabled
boolean

Specifies whether password expiration is enabled for the admin

passwordExpiryDays
int32

Password expiration duration, calculated in days
